title: Can’t live without this app
body: I’ve been using this myself for nearly a year now and it helps me greatly with my daily routine. I have a very poor working memory and have trouble putting things in order. This does the hard work for me and I can feel much more in control 👌🏻 Highly recommend for kids too. Since I’ve been having trouble getting my 5yr old organised and staying on task to be ready for school in the mornings, I’ve put a list just for her onto the iPad. 1 month in and ITS A LIFE SAVER 🙌🏻. She now finally has the motivation and the visual aid to focus on getting ready and its still working so well! Before I had tried a laminated list of pictures stuck on the wall for her to cross off with a whiteboard marker each day but it never lasted. The bright colours and the little sounds in this app are absolutely perfect for that satisfaction of ticking off a task. It’s simple and perfect 😍

Pretty much defeats the purpose of a habit tracker if the app is always adding an extra count that I have to manually remove each time. On a personal note, I really dislike not being able to swipe between days anymore; the UI just adds additional steps to change the date - as another user mentions, it’s like the updates have taken the app backwards!

The latest updates have removed features that are working well, and ignored features that are not functioning. 

I’ve emailed the developer directly and responded to their request for footage; I’ve had no response. It saddens me that there is no indication anything will be fixed; I really loved this app but will have to move to another one.
